name: gcp-cloud-run
description: Deploy to Google Cloud Run, keyless: the platform's OIDC token is exchanged through Workload Identity Federation for the deploy service account — a connect script trusting the platform for one organization; one service per scope; the CI pushes the image to Artifact Registry with one overlay for every language on the images-base build and runtime images; readiness checks (token exchange, roles with the gcloud fix, image published, service state); traffic split, rollback, verify, diagnose
author: actionplatform
needs: env: AP_GCP_CLOUD_RUN_PROJECT_ID, AP_GCP_CLOUD_RUN_REGION, AP_GCP_CLOUD_RUN_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER, AP_GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE_ACCOUNT (the plugin's options on the platform), AP_APP

net: sts.googleapis.com, iamcredentials.googleapis.com, run.googleapis.com, artifactregistry.googleapis.com, cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com, iam.googleapis.com; the service's *.run.app url for the health check
tool: gcloud, only for `action-platform gcp-cloud-run connect`
